episodes.title: Yamato, il nuovo viaggio
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver combattuto contro l'impero della Cometa bianca, la Yamato ritorna sulla Terra per le riparazioni e per imbarcare nuovi membri dell'equipaggio. Desler ritorna sul suo pianeta natale per rendere un ultimo omaggio, ma si imbatte nella flotta del Black Nebula Empire, il cui obiettivo successivo è Iscandar. Desler, con l'aiuto di Kodai e dell'equipaggio della Yamato, decide di partire in soccorso della regina Starscha.

episodes.title: The Blessings of Life
episodes.synopsis: With her romance over, Retsuko fills the void with a virtual boyfriend. Her savings take a massive hit when she spends recklessly on in-game purchases.

episodes.title: Deep in the Hole
episodes.synopsis: Retsuko inadvertently backs into a parked car, damaging the other vehicle. Desperate for repair money, she reaches out to Gori for a loan.

episodes.title: A Sheltered Life
episodes.synopsis: To repay her debt, Retsuko starts working as the accounting manager for an underground idol group. In reality, she's at their beck and call.

episodes.title: Winds of Change
episodes.synopsis: The OTMGirls turn a profit for the first time thanks to Retsuko’s business acumen. Haida hits it off with Inui after an unexpected encounter.

episodes.title: An Urchin in the Desert
episodes.synopsis: After seeing Retsuko sing, Hyodo proposes that Retsuko become the lead vocalist, demoting Manaka in the process.

episodes.title: Crossroads
episodes.synopsis: The group’s popularity soars after a blogger's favorable review. Concerned by Retsuko's recent odd behavior, Haida secretly tails her to Hokkaido.

episodes.title: An Impenetrable Wall
episodes.synopsis: The OTMGirls receive an offer to perform at a rock festival. Hyodo rebrands the idols as a band, and the members must now learn to play instruments.

episodes.title: Bursting Her Bubble
episodes.synopsis: Manaka’s devotion to instrumental mastery inspires others to step up. Haida agrees to teach Retsuko guitar, but he invites Inui over on the same day.

episodes.title: The End of the Moratorium
episodes.synopsis: Inui opens up to Haida about her feelings, but he's unable to respond. Director Ton lectures Retsuko when he learns she has a side gig.

episodes.title: When You Count to Ten
episodes.synopsis: She's shaken, but Retsuko acts normal in front of her bandmates after a deranged fan accosts her. Haida struggles to choose between Retsuko and Inui.

info.title: Classic★Stars
info.synopsis: L'accademia privata Gloria è un luogo dove vengono riunite le stelle nascenti nel campo della musica, dell'arte e dello sport. Nel dipartimento di musica gli studenti che risultano compatibili possono ricevere il "Dono" di famosi musicisti del passato, che gli viene impiantato in modo che possano eguagliare il loro talento assumendo pure i nomi di questi famosi maestri. La storia si concentra su Beethoven, uno studente che si scopre compatibile con il "Dono" e viene ammesso alla prestigiosa accademia.

episodes.title: For My Own Soul
episodes.synopsis: An injured boxer transfers to Gloria Academy and ends up in the music dept. to find he has a "gift."

episodes.title: Nachtmusik Will Change into Wings
episodes.synopsis: Mozart was offered to write music for ice skater, Misha Cartin. Will he be able to impress the Ice Prince?

episodes.title: Reality Through the Filtered Lens
episodes.synopsis: After scoring low on his exam, Beethoven gets appointed a tutor by Miharagi. And that tutor is… Chopin?!

episodes.title: Tonight, Enjoy a Playful Dream
episodes.synopsis: Frustrated, Beethoven runs into Liszt, who sheds a new light on his situation. Will Beethoven find his path?

episodes.title: Howl, Sing, Create
episodes.synopsis: Now that Beethoven has decided to join, he must prove to his teammates how serious he is by writing a song.

episodes.title: The First Star
episodes.synopsis: It's showtime. Beethoven must make up for lost time as they practice their routine for the preliminaries.

episodes.title: Acceptance of the Heart
episodes.synopsis: The group feels hopeless as tension rises between the members. Will a trip to the hot springs reunite them?

episodes.title: Love Is Freedom
episodes.synopsis: Qualifying in the preliminary, the group is ready to move on, except Liszt. Will Gran★MyStar lose a member?!

episodes.title: A Rough Nightmare
episodes.synopsis: Every time Chopin sees his own reflection, he refuses to look. Will he be able to fight off his inner demons?

episodes.title: An Irreversible Note
episodes.synopsis: Mozart's traumatic past is triggered when "he" appears. Will Mozart overcome it and look to the future?

episodes.title: Light Up the Love for Music in This Beat
episodes.synopsis: The spotlight turns back to Beethoven and the team's efforts to rekindle their musical spark ahead of the final showcase. Rivalries heat up, unexpected guests return, and the characters confront their own creative blockages.

episodes.title: One to Place Judgment
episodes.synopsis: With Beethoven critically injured, will Gran★MyStar be able to perform at the finals and surpass DIs=Cord?!

episodes.title: Stars Melody
episodes.synopsis: As the last performers, will Gran★MyStar manage to take the top?! The world is in for a surprise.

info.title: The Devil Lady (ITA)
info.synopsis: Devil Lady' è una serie TV del 1998 ispirata al Devil Man di Go Nagai. L’eroina di turno è Jun Fudo, una modella famosa, divenuta suo malgrado una Devilman che combatte i Beast (esseri mutanti che perdono totalmente la razionalità umana) per difendere le sorti dell’umanità.

episodes.title: Beast
episodes.synopsis: Jun just seems to be going through the motions in her photo shoot, although the photographer seems to think she is doing wonderfully. Jun seems to be having a problem with mirrors and reflections today, even when they are behind curtains. Jun meets Lan Asuka, a mysterious woman, who introduces Jun to the supernatural in an overwhelming way. Kazumi is Jun's tie to normalcy. Will Jun be able to hang on after being introduced to the beast?

episodes.title: Blood
episodes.synopsis: The battle continues. Jun is called upon to handle more than she ever imagined. She exhibits abilities that were unimagined by the Human Alliance (HA), to meet an unexpected challenge. Jun still can't believe what is happening and wonders if it was all a nightmare.

episodes.title: Wings
episodes.synopsis: Jun begins to make enemies. Those that would destroy humankind make it clear that Jun and her loved ones are fair game in the war. They cannot understand why she holds onto her inferior human side. Catastrophe strikes someone close to Jun. Jun continues to find new abilities to the surprise of her enemies and the HA.

episodes.title: Seed
episodes.synopsis:
Jun is still reeling from previous incidents, and reflects on how she was different from others. She falls into self-pity, as she is seemingly being held captive by the H A, the very organization that utilizes her to destroy other beasts. Jun is leery of people in shadows, thanks to her last encounter.
A new beast with an unusual characteristic is discovered. This new characteristic doesn't make it any less dangerous. Asuka discovers a new power of Jun's.

episodes.title: Shark
episodes.synopsis:
Thanks to Asuka, Jun has an unplanned reunion with an old friend from high school where they didn't part in a friendly manner. Jun and her ex-classmate had a difference of opinion on what the relationship should be. It seems that all anger has dissipated, but has it?
Meanwhile Kazumi feels a little left out. But there is no need to worry. Jun's encounter strengthens the bond to Kazumi.

episodes.title: Cat
episodes.synopsis: Jun experiences a love / hate relationship first-hand, when she meets someone who idolizes her and loves cats. What do you do when you are so talented that you inspire love and hate? You face it head on! Is Jun up to the task?

episodes.title: Fog
episodes.synopsis: With each transformation, the risk increases that Jun will lose her human side. Is it possible that the childhood story of the Grim Reaper will be Jun's undoing? Recent events take Jun's thoughts back to the story her grandfather told her hoping she would go to bed. Of course Jun's curiosity was only increased. Is her next foe The Grim Reaper?

episodes.title: Enemy
episodes.synopsis: The HA continues their attempt to keep the general population from discovering the devil beast phenomenon. A broadcaster attempts to release the news of the devil beasts. Jun is introduced to Dr Jason Bates, an American from the Samuelson Lab. Jason has come to observe the giga effect, which transforms the devil beasts into giants. He doesn't believe that beasts are inherently evil and that devil beasts can hold on to their human soul. Jun's confrontation with the broadcaster doesn't go as planned causing Dr Bates to doubt Jun's strength. Asuka feels humiliated and berates Jun.

episodes.title: Eyes
episodes.synopsis:
Jun dwells upon her previous failure and the disappointments of Asuka and Jason. While looking into a store window, Jun feels someone watching her. Jun finds herself in the park in a photo shoot.
Kazumi is interviewed and photographed. She also meets someone who has an interest in what happened to her family.
Those around Jun begin to question her sanity when she seems to continually feel watched. Is she being watched, or is it just her imagination?

episodes.title: Flames
episodes.synopsis:
A large fire at the Sakura Housing Complex looks suspicious. Firemen are surprised to find a a survivor in the rubble. Asuka and Jun disagree on how the small survivor should be treated. Asuka believes the survivor to be a devil beast, since survival would have been impossible otherwise. The fact of the HA having no experience with a devil beast being a child doesn't temper Asuka's belief. The Biochemical Investigations Team decides to study the child.
Kazumi reviews a videotape that was sent by Sakazawa. Remembering his earlier comment she wonders about Jun. Jun's frequent and sudden departures don't help Kazumi's confidence in their relationship.

episodes.title: Box
episodes.synopsis: A department store executive disappears after being falsely accused. Unfortunately, he isn't the only one who disappears. Jun is called in to handle this situation in an all too public department store building, all just in time for Christmas. Jun discovers his box as well as her own…

episodes.title: Faces
episodes.synopsis:
Jun has visions of a devil beast world. Does her demonic side want such a world? Yuasa offers to lighten Jun's workload. When Jun runs into Jason in the street, they go to a cavern bar.
Jason accuses Jun of enjoying the kill, and yet calls her weak mentally and physically. Maeda tells Jun that she will need to accompany him as soon as she gets home. The authorities are finding victims with their face missing. Meanwhile, Jason still obsesses over Jun's and some of the other beasts' ability to manifest the giga effect. Asuka's orders reflect her belief that beasts in the giga effect are no longer in control, endangering Jun's life.

episodes.title: Rope
episodes.synopsis:
A man is restrained in a remote residence. A woman entices him.
Jun has a photo shoot with inexperienced model Takai, a high school student that is more intimate than usual. Jun shows interest in a phone call that Yuasa receives during the photo shoot. After the photo shoot Jun acts inappropriately with Takai and shows regret.
Jun sees Sakazawa speaking to Kazumi and Yuasa in separate incidences. She concludes the man is a nuisance.
Asuka picks up Jun and tells her they are going for a ride in the country. She tells Jun they have found a victim with one-third of the blood drained from the body. Will Jun fall into the trap found by this young victim?

episodes.title: Home
episodes.synopsis: Sakazawa remembers his life before the beast obsession. All devil beasts are alike aren't they? Will Sakazawa always believe this? Kazumi is missing and Jun will do what it takes to find her. Meanwhile, Kazumi realizes she has been used, but isn't quite sure for what. The HA has their hands full with another beast, and receives unexpected help. The battle between the beast factions now begins to accelerate.

episodes.title: Crows
episodes.synopsis: Kazumi's conversation after a photo shoot, plants the seeds of remembrance regarding her parents death. Bodies begin to show up on top of lamp posts, utility poles and other odd places. Shiro Kazawa's warnings replay through Kazumi's mind. Crows show up in the oddest places. The HA thinks Jun needs a chauffeur. Kazumi once again becomes noticed by the beasts. Jun continues to amaze those who witness her power, but will it be enough to save Kazumi?

episodes.title: Voice
episodes.synopsis: The dead bodies on top of traffic posts continue. The HA begins to have trouble keeping the secret of the devil beasts. Maeda gets directly involved in the fight against devil beasts. Kazumi's voice is a God-send to Jun.

episodes.title: Hunger
episodes.synopsis: Saturo continues to recruit beasts to his cause. His statement that Jun is hated by the humans seems to be manifesting itself. Jun appears to be losing control of her beast side. Where is Asuka?

episodes.title: Body
episodes.synopsis: The battle between humans and devil beasts is worsening. Jun is surprised by Asuka and Jason. Can Jason keep his human side if he gets his wish? Asuka's behavior is drawing the attention of the HA.

episodes.title: Fetters
episodes.synopsis: Kazumi is still getting used to the idea of the beasts in the open. Can she learn to trust any devil beast other than Jun? Yuasa is surprised to see Maeda after their last conversation. Maeda becomes more suspicious of Asuka. Jun continues to be a fugitive. The battle with the beast is no longer a secret. Yuasa and Jun temporarily relive a normal work day. Yuasa's family has a stressful day, while he lives in a fanciful moment.

episodes.title: Corpses
episodes.synopsis: This episode goes to America. This episode Lan gets a new private secretary, Captain Izume Kogure. Maeda gets some American help. Jun meets some old acquaintances that she's not particularly wanting to see. Jun meets a new more powerful associate of Satoro's. Maeda discovers Lan's secret past. Jun and Satoro have a battle of the wills.

episodes.title: Signs
episodes.synopsis: What is this RNA Transmutation Innoculation? Maeda discovers the truth and informs Jun. Kazumi becomes closer to her new friends, but still wants to be with Jun. Will they be reunited? Will Jun be able to overcome the organized beasts?

episodes.title: Wish
episodes.synopsis: Jun receives help from an unexpected source, when defeat is imminent. Will it be enough? Kazumi remembers her first meeting with Jun. Hostility increases between humans and the devil beasts. Devil beasts are rounded up as Satoro gathers his army. Izumi is concerned about Lan Asuka. Jun inspires a fond childhood memory in Kazumi. Kazumi wants to help Jun in a new way. Will she get her wish?

episodes.title: Life
episodes.synopsis: Jun is legendary among the gentler beasts as the champion of their kind. Kazumi's influence inspires hope in her recently found friends. They expect Jun to rescue them. Lan's plan becomes more apparent. Jun faces a beast with unexpected strength. Lan is still involved with the US, but why? What is her relationship to Jun?

episodes.title: Heart
episodes.synopsis: Home is where the heart is. Jun befriends a new young companion who understands Jun's past too well. Unfortunately Chiyoko doesn't understand why Jun had to do all that she did. She doesn't understand the fine line that Jun mustn't cross.

episodes.title: God
episodes.synopsis: Beasts are kept like prisoners. Asuka can't wait for Jun's return. Kiyoko, Misaki, Takae and Takeshi try to avoid extermination in the beast prison. Asuka sends a not so friendly welcoming party when Jun returns to Tokyo. What is the relationship between Jun and Asuka?

episodes.title: Man
episodes.synopsis: Asuka has appeared all over the world and is forcing the world to accept her as the new child of God. Jun awakes in a place like hell and sees all of the demons trapped in a tower forged of demon bodies. Jun decides to forge her soul with the force from the Demons leaving the hell like place to face off with Asuka. A battle of Heaven and Hell begins, but who will be victorious?

info.title: Seven Cities Story: Arctic Front
info.synopsis: Anno 2086, l'asse terrestre si inclina di 90° e nel giro di tre anni muoiono dieci miliardi di abitanti della Terra. Tuttavia circa un milione di coloni che si erano trasferiti sulla luna, sopravvivono. Alcuni coloni decidono di tornare sulla Terra per iniziare il ripopolamento del mondo ed in base al clima, alla stabilità sismica e alle risorse sotterranee, vengono selezionate sette nuove città. Tuttavia, mentre costruivano queste città, il Governo Mondiale istituito sulla Luna, crea un sistema per controllare completamente il pianeta Terra, il Sistema Olympos, che tramite satelliti militari.

info.title: Lupin III: Return of Pycal (ITA)
info.synopsis: Dal passato di Lupin III emerge un temibile avversario creduto morto. Si tratta di Pycal, detto "Il mago", un uomo senza scrupoli e in grado di mettere in atto i trucchi più incredibili. Sia Lupin sia Pycal sono interessati a impossessarsi dei sette prismi di cristallo, il cui mistero risale nientemeno che all'antica Grecia del filosofo e matematico Pitagora. Chi vincerà questa volta la partita, impadronendosi dell'ambito bottino e del fuggevole cuore della bella Fujiko?

episodes.title: OVA
episodes.synopsis: Lupin steals an extraordinary gem from a Mediterranean party, only to be interrupted by Pycal, the trickster "magician" who had apparently died fighting Lupin early in his career. Pycal, now armed with real magical abilities, is determined to take revenge.

info.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
info.synopsis: Il fidanzamento fra Scarlet ed il secondo principe Kyle è stato improvvisamente annullato durante un ballo. Falsamente accusata di aver molestato Tenerezza, la figlia di un barone che era particolarmente adorata da Kyle, viene condannata da tutte le famiglie aristocratiche che iniziano ad incolparla per ogni genere di crimine. Dopo aver sopportato per anni gli abusi e l'idiozia del principe, ora la ragazza ha raggiunto il suo limite. "Prima di andarmene, posso chiederti un ultimo favore?" chiese prima di dare un pugno in faccia a Kyle. Così inizia la storia di vendetta di Scarlett, una combattente elegante ma ribelle che non ha più intenzione che qualcuno si approfitti di lei!

episodes.title: May I Kindly Beat the Tar Out of Those Evil Nobles (Pigs)?
episodes.synopsis: When "villainess" Scarlet's fiancé dumps her at a ball, she requests an unexpected form of satisfaction.

episodes.title: May I Offer You the Taste of My Fist as the Ladylike Thing to Do?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet's behavior at the ball has unexpected consequences, including a direct attempt on her life!

episodes.title: I Considered a Negotiated Resolution, but May I Biff and Pow Those Noblemen Instead?
episodes.synopsis: To take down the kingdom's slave trader, Scarlet negotiates access to the upcoming slave auction.

episodes.title: May I Go to See My Fists` Beloved One (Punching Bag)?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet infiltrates the slave auction, but her priority is to find and pummel Lord Godwin.

episodes.title: May I Clobber This Asshole Prince?
episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath of the slave auction raid, Scarlet and Julius consider their next moves.

episodes.title: May I Send This Pig Flying into the Sky?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet is to accompany Saint Diana's Holy Land Pilgrimage, but the servants of Palmianism stand in her way.

episodes.title: May I Carry Out a Plan That Shows a New Side of You?
episodes.synopsis: Diana explores new feelings while Scarlet explores a festival looking for new people to punch.

episodes.title: May I Offer You a Fist in Place of a Handkerchief?
episodes.synopsis: The pilgrimage proceeds to Snowind, where Scarlet and her crew receive a less than warm welcome.

episodes.title: May I Explain That This Is Not Something That Just Anyone Can Do?
episodes.synopsis: While threats approach from all sides, Diana is racked with guilt over Scarlet's condition.

episodes.title: May I Cook This Thick Cut of Pork Through with Body Punches?
episodes.synopsis: Julius negotiates with an unexpected ally while Scarlet hones her fists for a new kind of feast.

episodes.title: As These Appear Undercooked, May I Turn Them Into Mince Meat?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet and her friends continue to deal with the external threats, but the source of the problem remains.

episodes.title: May I Pay Off the Massive Debt My Fists Have Accrued?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet pursues a final reckoning with Terenezza, but the would-be heroine has a cruel plan in store.

episodes.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet is ready to deal her last punch to Terenezza, but she must first overcome a mind-controlled Julius.

info.title: Mahoromatic: I'm Home!
info.synopsis: Suguru e i suoi compagni di classe si preparano per un maid café per celebrare l’anniversario della città. Nel frattempo, Minawa viene attaccata da dei robot. Mahoro cerca di salvare Minawa e di aiutare Suguru e i suoi compagni a preparare il maid café.

episodes.title: The Returning Wind
episodes.synopsis: While Mahoro is teaching everyone how to be a maid for their new store Cafe Trois, Minowa is attacked by the robots from Management.

episodes.title: The Returning Sky
episodes.synopsis: As Mahoro helps out at Cafe Trois on the opening day, she senses danger. When the robot henchmen close in, Mahoro rushes to Minowa's aid.

info.title: High School! Kimengumi (2026)
info.synopsis: L'eccentrico e selvaggio Kimengumi torna nell'era Reiwa con la sua commedia giovanile ad altissima energia!

episodes.title: Enter Kimengumi!
episodes.synopsis: Yui Kawa has just transferred to Class 3-5 at Ichio Junior High. According to her seatmate, Chie Uru, this school is home to many oddballs-some of them, in particular, the "oddest among all oddballs": five individuals with extraordinary appearances and equally extraordinary personalities, known as Kimengumi. Chasing after these unruly characters, Yui's unpredictable school life begins!

episodes.title: New Semester: The Ultimate Self-Introduction / A Battle Without Rules: Classmates United
episodes.synopsis: In the blink of an eye, the cast blows up-well, graduates from- Ichio Junior High and moves on to the next stage: Ichio High School! As the usual crew and a colorful group of new classmates gather, Rei is the only one missing…? / Yui, Kimengumi, and their classmates head to a bowling alley on a day off. A sudden bowling match kicks off, and Yui herself somehow ends up as the prize…?

episodes.title: The Gag Effect of Kindness!? / Blessings for the Contrarian
episodes.synopsis: Chie is furious with Yui, and the cause seems to be one of Yui's meddlesome remarks. Rei, who bumps into the furious Chie, starts talking to her about how kindness can backfire… / Jako Amano, the leader of Omegumi, is a contrarian. Both students and teachers tend to avoid her, as she always finds fault in everything, and Jako herself is well aware of this too, but still…

episodes.title: Leap Through Time! The Hot-Blooded Teacher / Dai Monohoshi, Do You Have Any Backbone in You?
episodes.synopsis: The freewheeling-as-usual Class 1-5 welcomes a new vice homeroom teacher today! Dreaming of becoming a passionate teacher in the old-school, Showa-era way, Mr. Jidai is left stunned by Kimengumi's eccentricity. / Wakazo Temekono, the school gang leader at Ichio High School, is searching for a successor. Spotting Dai, he sets out to toughen Dai up, only to find himself completely toyed with instead…

episodes.title: Don Harumage the Nemesis Approaches! / Let`s Play Somewhere in the Universe
episodes.synopsis: Kimengumi, Yui, and Chie visit Rei's house to hang out. In Rei's childhood photo album, they notice a boy who appears beside Rei in every picture…? Rei's fated rival, Don Harumage, enters the fray! / Don struggles to fit in with his new class as a transfer student. One stormy day, Don and Rei come across a mysterious creature. Naming it Pochi, the two bring the creature to school, but…

episodes.title: Shy Boy Go / Please Tell Me All About Marriage
episodes.synopsis: Chie is taking time off from school after breaking her leg. As the girls discuss visiting the injured Chie, Go, who is watching from afar, seems to have something on his mind… / Ms. Ikari and Mr. Sessa are getting married!? While the teachers aren't exactly displeased by the excitement among the students, they can't help worrying about Kimengumi, who have been invited to the wedding after-party…

episodes.title: Kiri`s Hide-and-Seek Wars! / Kiyoshi Syusse: A Pervert No Matter What
episodes.synopsis: Kiri Ichido is a straight-A honor student, but her perfect image is now at risk because of a home visit! The Ichido family is full of people she can't bring herself to introduce to her homeroom teacher…/Sho Kireide, leader of Irootokogumi, is as popular as ever. Meanwhile, Kiyoshi has just had his heart broken by what felt like love at first sight.

episodes.title: Seaside Chase / A Midsummer Night`s Poppin` Shower
episodes.synopsis: Yui and the girls head to the beach. The members of Udegumi are also there, apparently working part-time. Suddenly, something rises from the calm sea…it's Ja●s and the Umibozu!? / Kimengumi is so thrilled about the summer fireworks festival that the teachers' warning-"Don't go overboard!"-falls on deaf ears. However, Go has to help out at home that day…

episodes.title: Sleepy Bug Jin / About Your Cooking...
episodes.synopsis: Today is just another ordinary day for the Daima family, as Jin's parents try every possible way to wake him up. They somehow manage to send him off, but Jin's laid-back attitude doesn't stop, even after he gets to school. / Yui comes to school acting strange. The reason is that Rei showed up in her dream that morning. Meanwhile, Rei also seems to have something he wants to tell Yui…?

episodes.title: Let`s Go on a School Trip
episodes.synopsis: The students at Ichio High School are off on a school trip! Rumor has it that an extremely fancy dinner awaits them in the evening. Unfortunately, the leaders of each group are left behind as the bus departs! By the time they finally make it to the hotel, the dinner has already been completely eaten.

episodes.title: Chara-llel World
episodes.synopsis: Yui is with Rei on their usual way to school. When they arrive at school, everyone seems to act different from usual. As they grow confused at the unfamiliar Chie and the members of other groups, another Yui and Rei appear!? What's more, their alternate versions have entirely different personalities and do not seem to get along at all…

episodes.title: Kimengumi Back in the Day
episodes.synopsis: Seeing the small park nearby, Kimengumi and Chie get excited as they reminisce about their childhood, and Yui can't help but feel a little envious. The group then decides to watch one of Rei's videos titled "I Ran an Errand Today!".

info.title: High Speed Jessie
info.synopsis: Jecy è un giovane in cerca di vendetta; ha perso i genitori per mano del sindacato criminale organizzato chiamato Bismark House - un gruppo a caccia di un prodotto chiamato "lyzorium" a qualsiasi costo. Con incredibili abilità come velocità e agilità aumentate, Jecy viaggia attraverso lo spazio con una ragazza di nome Tiana; Fork Green, un prete della religione Heartland che uccide i criminali lentamente per mandarli in paradiso; e una nave vivente chiamata Paolon. Tuttavia, la vendetta di Jecy non sarà facile - una donna di nome Jera, il suo fratellino assetato di sangue Cross e numerosi altri avversari gli sbarrano la strada!

episodes.title: Prologue
episodes.synopsis: Night in the city, and some local thugs are on the prowl. A priest of Hartland catches them and is vetting out justice. But before he can act, Jecy intervenes, catching the attention of a mysterious woman. But her offer of a job later ends up more than he bargained for. With his companion Tiana hostage, completing a dangerous task is Jecy's only means to rescue her.

info.title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm (ITA)
info.synopsis: Yuru vive in un piccolo villaggio in montagna, conducendo una vita serena vivendo di caccia di uccelli. Mentre la sorella gemella di Yuru stranamente sembra avere un "compito" nella prigione del villaggio come se fosse intrappolata. Un mistero viene fuori in questo villaggio apparentemente sereno, cosa si nasconde dietro?

episodes.title: Asa and Yuru
episodes.synopsis: In a world where certain humans command mighty supernatural duos called Daemons, it is the birthright of "the children who sunder day and night"—twins Yuru and Asa—to rule over these powerful entities. Separated from a young age and unaware of the truth of their birth, brother and sister must fight to make their way back to each other, claim their birthright, and save the world...

episodes.title: Left and Right
episodes.synopsis: Guided by Dera, Yuru flees from his pursuers and awakens the guardian deities of the village.

episodes.title: Dera and Hana
episodes.synopsis: Yuru learns the truth about his village and learns the rules of modern society as he rides down the mountain.

episodes.title: Jin and Yuru
episodes.synopsis: After a short rest, Yuru and his Daemons begin their search for Asa by sniffing out her blood.

episodes.title: Hare and Tortoise
episodes.synopsis: Yuru and his Daemons track the scent of Asa's blood to a warehouse, where they encounter Jin and his men.

episodes.title: The Kagemori Clan and the Unknown Assailants
episodes.synopsis: Yuru is reunited with Asa at the Kagemori mansion and asks her about their parents.

episodes.title: Asa and Break
episodes.synopsis: The morning after the battle, Yuru asks about the eyepatch covering her right eye.

episodes.title: Suspicion and Conviction
episodes.synopsis: Dera arrives at the Kagemori mansion to retrieve Yuru, and they're invited to breakfast by the clan head.

episodes.title: Embrace and Whisper
episodes.synopsis: In order to cheer Yuru up, Dera drags him and his Daemons around the city to see the sights.

episodes.title: Long-Arm and Long-Leg
episodes.synopsis: While shopping in the city, Yuru and Dera sense that they’re being followed.

episodes.title: Big Brother and Little Brother
episodes.synopsis: After defeating Long-Arm and Long-Leg, the group realizes something else had been tailing them all along.

episodes.title: Retainer and Shaman
episodes.synopsis: Ken moves in with Yuru and the others and asks Yuru to help him become stronger.

episodes.title: Daikyo and Shokyo
episodes.synopsis: Higashi Village is attacked by a man wielding katana Daemons.

episodes.title: Family and Friends
episodes.synopsis: Yuru and Ken notice someone following them while looking for a place to practice shooting a bow.

episodes.title: Yuru and Danji
episodes.synopsis: Feeling betrayed by Danji, Yuru asks for space so he can think by himself.

episodes.title: Kagemori and Shingo
episodes.synopsis: Yuru and Dera head to the warehouses at night to meet Ivan.

episodes.title: Crybaby and Naughty Child
episodes.synopsis: The traitor attacks Asa while she's alone, but the Kagemoris have set a trap for him.

episodes.title: Fujin and Raijin
episodes.synopsis: At the Kagemori mansion, the traitor is captured. Meanwhile, Gonzo overpowers the Shingo clan.

episodes.title: Sword and Bow
episodes.synopsis: Asa rescues the hostages, and Yuru faces off against Ivan.

episodes.title: The Hunted and the Hunter
episodes.synopsis: After an intense battle, Ivan escapes. He teleports back to Shingo, who appears to be in trouble.

episodes.title: Zashiki-Warashi and Higashi Village
episodes.synopsis: The Zashiki-Warashi, Danji and Kiri, tell Asa and Yuru what they know about Higashi Village.

episodes.title: The Kagemori Brothers and the Kuroya Siblings
episodes.synopsis: Natsuki demands to know why Akio betrayed the Kagemori clan, but he offers no explanation.

episodes.title: Emotion and Reason
episodes.synopsis: Akio escapes from the Kagemoris, and Yuru comes down with a fever.

episodes.title: Higashi Village and Nishino Village
episodes.synopsis: Yuru dreams about the day bandits tried to kill him as a kid, and Asa blames herself for the gardener's death.

info.title: My Hero Academia: More (ITA)
info.synopsis: Special animato in cui viene raccontata la storia di Deku e degli amici dopo l'episodio finale. Le vicende sono state pubblicate da Kohei Horikoshi nel 42° e ultimo volume del manga originale.

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis: Time has passed, and the former members of Class 1-A have grown up, but something is bothering Uraraka...

info.title: Shuten Doji - The Star Hand Kid (ITA)
info.synopsis: La storia segue le vicende di Jiro Shutendo, un ragazzo che scopre di essere la reincarnazione del mitologico demone Shutendoji. Sospeso tra la sua natura umana e una spaventosa eredità demoniaca, Jiro si ritrova a dover combattere oscure minacce in un mix di horror, mitologia giapponese e fantascienza.

episodes.title: Chapter of Hyoki
episodes.synopsis: A huge oni arrives on Earth carrying a precious cargo: a baby boy, which he leaves with a young human couple with the instructions that they are to raise him as their own until the oni returns in 15 years.

episodes.title: Chapter of Goma
episodes.synopsis: Jiro gets attacked at some temple and a bunch of new characters show up to help him. This new team escapes and returns to Jiro's house for introductions, not that this matters since his mom and Miyuki get kidnapped and they have to rush to the rescue.

episodes.title: Chapter of Tekki
episodes.synopsis: Jiro's mom has gone insane over the loss of her boy and is sent to a mental institution. Jiro and the rest are in some dimension being attacked by Oni of all colours and Jiro ends up in space while the rest end up in ancient Japan.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Past
episodes.synopsis: An adoptive father, an old photo, and the day two powers first crossed paths.

episodes.title: The Caged Beast
episodes.synopsis: Searching for Xia Fei means going where no one looks. That has never stopped Cheng Xiaoshi.

episodes.title: Bloodbath in Laos
episodes.synopsis: Faced with a crisis, can Cheng Xiaoshi save Xia Fei, or will help come from someone else?

episodes.title: Jae
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious visitor from Bridon disrupts the photo studio's peace. What has he come for?

episodes.title: Welcome Banquet
episodes.synopsis: Over a steaming hot pot feast, rival factions quietly begin to clash.

episodes.title: Testing the Waters
episodes.synopsis: A forgotten childhood photo resurfaces in a test across time and space. But who is the real prey?

episodes.title: Chinatown Investigation
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi possesses a young Vein and encounters Xia Fei's father in Chinatown, uncovering a cruel truth.

episodes.title: Blood-Red Storm
episodes.synopsis: The secret behind the Chinatown family massacre.

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.synopsis: Xia Fei's intentions are revealed, along with Lu Guang's motives.

episodes.title: Misplaced Redemption
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi relives lost memories and discovers that the past he wants to save is already broken.

episodes.title: The Exit Disappears
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi jumps between photos as the paths back to the present close one by one.

episodes.title: Welcome Home
episodes.synopsis: Trapped between memories and photographs, Cheng Xiaoshi searches for a way back.
